definitions.gloss: edge of eaves; under the eaves
definitions.explanation: the area just outside a building, under the overhang of the roof
the front of a shop, often where goods are displayed

examples.japanese: {軒先|のきさき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{雨宿|あまやど}り→雨宿り：14929_amayadori⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I took shelter from the rain under the eaves.

examples.japanese: {軒先|のきさき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{風鈴|ふうりん}→風鈴：09929_fuurin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{下|さ}がっている→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧。
examples.english: A wind chime is hanging from the eaves.

examples.japanese: ツバメ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{軒先|のきさき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{巣|す}→巣：02140_su⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: A swallow built a nest under the eaves.

examples.japanese: {軒先|のきさき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{並|なら}べて→並べる：01091_naraberu⟧⟦{売|う}っている→売る：00906_uru⟧。

examples.english: I bought fresh fish sold at the storefront.

notes:
Refers to the area just in front of a building, under the overhang of the roof. Also used for the front of a shop where goods are displayed.

FORMS:
⟦{軒|のき}→軒：03912_noki⟧ (eaves) + ⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧ (tip, front)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:

- {軒先|のきさき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}べる→並べる：01091_naraberu⟧: to display/line up in front of a shop
